# Danesh P M

> Backend and DevOps engineer based in Bengaluru, India. Builds Java and Spring Boot REST APIs, containerised deployments (Docker, Kubernetes) and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines with DevSecOps security scanning (SonarQube, Trivy, OWASP ZAP). Also works with Python, MLOps and Next.js.

## Profile
- Role: Backend & DevOps Engineer (early career)
- Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Education: B.E. Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Vijaya Vittala Institute of Technology (VTU), 2021-2025, CGPA 9+
- Experience: DevOps Intern at IBM (Sep-Dec 2024, VTU-PMKVY AICTE program); Machine Learning Intern at PRAGYAN AI (Oct-Nov 2023); ML with Python Intern at COMSOFT Technology (Oct-Nov 2022)
- Core skills: Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security (JWT), Hibernate/JPA, REST APIs, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, SonarQube, Trivy, OWASP ZAP, AWS EC2, Linux, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Python, TypeScript, Next.js, React, MLflow
